item.title: k8s-aibom: finding out which AI workloads are actually running in your cluster
item.description: At some point someone from security or compliance asks the platform team a simple question: “Which models are we running in production, and where?” Usually nobody has a good answer. There’s a spreadsheet that was correct six months ago, a few Helm charts that mention vLLM, and that one team that deployed Ollama in a dev namespace “just to try something” and forgot about it. k8s-aibom is an open source controller from Google Cloud that tries to answer this question by looking at the cluster itself.
